items.title: City of Columbia, SC — ransomware confirmed
items.summary: The city confirmed on ~Oct 24 that an incident found earlier that week was ransomware; several citizen-facing online services are down while 911, police, fire and water stayed protected, and SLED and the FBI are investigating possible data access.

items.title: Telangana TG-iPASS portal encrypted
items.summary: A single aggregator reported on Oct 25 that the state industrial-approvals portal's database was encrypted and the site taken offline; there is no official confirmation yet.

items.title: Osaka Public University — ~500 servers down
items.summary: Attack on Oct 2 breached the virtualization layer, took nearly 500 servers offline and encrypted many backups; data on ~130,000 students and alumni may be exposed and classes were suspended to Oct 9.

items.title: DexCom claimed by Redact group
items.summary: The medical device maker was listed on the Redact leak site on Oct 10; this is a group claim, not confirmed by the company.

items.title: Andersen Group — SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: The professional services firm was listed on Oct 6 in an attack attributed to SilentRansomGroup, with reported system disruption and extortion demands.

ransomware.note: Background: Check Point recorded reported ransomware attacks up 53% YoY in September, and Bitdefender counted 790 claimed victims that month. Most October victims are leak-site claims, not company confirmations.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 regional outage
items.summary: Third-party monitoring logged a 5h32m incident from 08:35 UTC on Oct 20 affecting 12 services, including Compute Engine, App Engine and Cloud Storage, in the London region.

items.title: Microsoft 365 via Global Secure Access — 11-hour outage
items.summary: On Oct 13, from 07:40 to 18:31 UTC, users in Germany and the UK who connect through GSA lost Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams and Windows 365 Cloud PCs; the workaround was to disable GSA.

items.title: Cloudflare Ashburn (IAD) degradation
items.summary: Network problems at the Ashburn, Virginia data center on Oct 13 were traced to maintenance on a third party's circuits, and traffic has since recovered.

items.title: Exchange Online hybrid mail-flow failure
items.summary: On Oct 8, mail flow from on-premises Exchange servers into Exchange Online failed for some tenants for about 4 hours.

outage.note: No AWS or Azure-wide outage found for October 2026. Most items come from third-party trackers, so confirm against official status pages.

items.title: Ahold Delhaize takes US and EU systems offline
items.summary: The global grocer confirmed on Oct 19 that a cybersecurity incident led it to proactively take websites, apps and other IT systems offline across most brands; stores stayed open and Albert Heijn's online channels have been restored. The type of attack has not been disclosed.

items.title: Argentine municipalities hit via software vendor PGM
items.summary: Multiple Argentine municipalities were disrupted through an attack on their shared software provider PGM, a supply-chain incident that is still unconfirmed.

items.title: CISA KEV: Joomla extension zero-days
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-48939 and CVE-2026-56291 to KEV after active exploitation of the Joomla iCagenda and Balbooa extensions.

items.title: Zero-day pace hits ~11/month (GTIG)
items.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group's Sept 30 analysis puts 2026's in-the-wild zero-day pace at about 11 per month, up from 8 in 2025, with 22 in August alone.

items.title: KEV volume: 247 adds YTD; BOD 26-04 in force
items.summary: KEV added 247 entries from Jan 1 to Oct 1, 2026, and most new entries carry the three-day remediation deadline under BOD 26-04, which replaced BOD 22-01 on June 10.

items.title: M 7.0 — 191 km ENE of Nagqu, Tibet, China
items.summary: M7.0 on the Tibetan Plateau on Oct 22 drew a USGS PAGER orange alert, meaning significant casualties or damage are likely.

items.title: M 7.0 doublet — Bonin Islands, Japan region
items.summary: USGS logged two M7.0 entries in the Bonin Islands region on Oct 24, followed by an M6.5 on Oct 25 that triggered a tsunami flag (green PAGER alert).

items.title: M 6.9 — WNW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu
items.summary: M6.9 offshore quake on Oct 24 with a tsunami flag and a green PAGER alert, meaning limited impact is expected.

physical.note: No verifiable October 2026 hurricane, typhoon, wildfire or flood reports turned up. Search results were misdated archive footage, so they were excluded. Check NHC/JTWC directly.
